verdict.rationale: Brave ships a dedicated LLM Context endpoint that returns pre-extracted, token-budgeted page content for RAG. It has configurable token and URL limits for sizing, Goggles re-ranking to control which sources ground the LLM, and adjustable relevance threshold modes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of context quality and ranking in real RAG pipelines.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get results sized and ranked for direct use as LLM context in a RAG pipeline

citations.quote: Pre-extracted page content for your LLM — no scraping, token-budgeted. This is the default for RAG, tools, and chatbots.
Fine-tune the amount of context with configurable token and URL limits
Control which sources ground your LLM using Brave's unique Goggles re-ranking system
Adjustable threshold modes ensure only relevant content reaches your LLM
The LLM Context endpoint is specifically built for machine consumption
